profile.headline: Software Architect & Engineer | Tech Leadership
profile.summary:
I grew up building things, breaking things, making art, DJing, wrestling, producing music, and trying every action sport.

The computer has always been a tool for me to create, connect, and learn.  I've been an active DJ and electronic music producer for most of my life, a.k.a. a professional software user. It wasn’t long until I became curious enough to look under the hood of these applications I was using everyday and step into the software development world.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Completed full time software development bootcamp focusing on development fundamen- tals and problem solving. Conducted daily application of project management and solution design through individual and group projects. Created full stack single page applications with Angular.js, Ruby on Rails, and plain HTML, CSS, & Javascript. Worked with a handful of Javascript libraries such as jQuery and handlebars. Deployed apps through Firebase. Built web scraping tools for projects. Worked with Google Optimization Library and Location/Map APIs. Used source code version control with Git/Github. Created servers and RESTful APIs with Ruby. Built database for CRUD functionality in SQLite.

positions.title: DJ/Producer
positions.description:
Not many DJs can claim they grew up DJing, however Eric, known as Evido, is one of the few.  From private events to clubs and festivals, Evido is a highly-respected DJ with a depth of music knowledge which can be witnessed in his DJ sets.  Since relocating to Nashville, he has held several DJ residencies and has performed on a handful of festival lineups.

Evido has a lengthy history performing with, and opening for internationally touring music acts such as Walker & Royce, Bingo Players, Mark Farina, Morgan Page, Cedric Gervais, Paul van Dyk, and many more.  He has DJed on the road for the hip hop duo Grits and 1GN.  Evido has DJed for brands such as Red Bull, Malibu Rum, Belvedere, Camp No Counselors, and Devoted Creations.

With a passion for dancing as well as producing music, Evido specializes in mixing and weaving tracks together, captivating the energy in the room.  His music has been supported on SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and A State Of Trance.  Evido also is an A&R manager for Cloudland Music, a niche dance music label that licenses music for radio shows such as Armin van Buuren’s A State Of Trance, Above & Beyond’s Group Therapy Radio, and many more.

projects.title: MowFlow - A Web App for landscape professionals to plan and optimize their schedules
projects.description: Built with Ruby on Rails, this app allows users to enter job information for each client and generate the most efficient work routing schedules. Coordinates from Google Places API for each client are sorted by job date and sent to the OSRM API to return a distance matrix. The distance matrix alongside job durations entered by the user are formatted and then ran through a custom-tailored python algorithm using the Google OR-Tools library to solve the “Traveling Salesman Problem” and the most efficient driving routes are returned. Users can reschedule jobs using the drag and drop calendar week view, view all jobs on a calendar month view or list view, view a client list, print a schedule and get Google Maps route information.

projects.title: SongSearch - An Aggregate Web Search Tool for DJs to use on the fly.
projects.description:
Link to repository - https://github.com/palmierie/front-end-capstone

Built with AngularJS, Browserify, Firebase, Bootstrap, and Materialize, this app allows users to search multiple music databases at once. The app grabs song data from iTunes using the iTunes API, Beatport (online music store) using a custom-built javascript web scraper, and Headliners Music Club (online record pool subscription service) using a custom-built JQuery web scraper. Results are displayed in a list with sort options, buy links, and save options (for signed in users). Signed in users can view a list of saved songs and toggle which music databases to search. With the current version, users must use a CORS Origin blocker, such as Moesif.
